test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven executives of a law firm (P, Q, R, S, T, U and V) are sitting at a circular table for a meeting, everyone facing towards the center (but not necessarily in the same order)

 
• P is an immediate neighbor of both U and S​
 
• Q is sitting to the immediate right of S, and is one of the immediate neighbors of T
 
• V is sitting second to the right of T.

Who is sitting second to the left of U?
solution:
**Given: **Seven executives of a law firm (P, Q, R, S, T, U and V) are sitting at a circular table for a meeting, everyone facing towards the center (but not necessarily in the same order)

P is an immediate neighbor of both U and S​

Q is sitting to the immediate right of S, and is one of the immediate neighbors of T

V is sitting second to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91959b791e54f65d0d9e39bec8aa60d141c259f984daac30230acd5ccc767e90.png] 

Thus, R is sitting second to the left of U.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
